description: Replace the accepted terminal's only explicit WMMA hot block in reduce_n2048_resident with a native Blackwell sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM pipeline. First resurrect the saved 64x16x8 K-major four-term TF32 path that was previously abandoned only because generic sm_100 blocked assembly; verify compute_100a/sm_100a code generation and native instructions, then optimize staging, MMA, TMEM readback and stores with warp-specialized producer/consumer overlap, ping-pong barriers/TMEM slots, and aligned TMA or cp.async.bulk factor movement. WMMA is an A/B baseline only, not the target terminal; preserve exact update/certificate behavior, the 45% n2048 guard, n176 integration, isolated concurrency fallback, forced modes and every other route.

Resurrected the saved direct 64x16x8 four-term TF32 resident update on the accepted integration and explicitly compiled the full extension for compute_100a/sm_100a. Build.ninja confirms -gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a; cuobjdump confirms an sm_100a cubin with four UTCHMMA instructions and LDTM.x16 in reduce_n2048_resident. Kernelguard and all 39 validations pass. Full geomean is 25286.997 us and n2048 is 299448.954 us versus parent 22648.370 aggregate and roughly 74 ms n2048. Nsys measures the native reducer at 108.211 ms per call and also shows cuSOLVER repair kernels, so both serialized tile staging and incorrect native result mapping/arithmetic must be addressed.

Bookkeeping correction for trial 0: the measured sm_100a direct-tcgen05 source is commit b399edd8e264855a8662cc0aa4cc7997056f58bf. The preceding row's commit field was mistyped; its build, 39/39 validation, 25286.997235 us aggregate, 299448.954 us n2048, sm_100a SASS, and profile evidence all belong to this exact commit.

Corrected the saved native operand contract using the in-run validated SM100 K-major packing: physical 8x4 atoms, descriptor leading dimensions 64/16 with stride 8, explicitly TF32-rounded residuals, and the M64 TMEM mapping where four reader warps participate and lanes 0-15 own rows warp*16+lane. Build, kernelguard, and 39/39 validation pass, but validation still returns the exact cuSOLVER-repair residual signature. Full geomean is 25340.591 us and n2048 305506.561 us versus 25286.997/299448.954 before the correction. This isolates the remaining corruption to cta_group::1 use by nonzero ranks in the eight-CTA cluster, matching prior in-run paired-cluster evidence that only rank 0 produced valid group-1 results.

Replaced per-CTA group-1 updates with four adjacent CTA pairs per eight-block cluster. Each pair stages local halves of an M128xN16 four-term TF32 update, the even rank issues cta_group::2 tcgen05, and both ranks decode 64-row TMEM halves; a cluster-wave scheduler keeps all pairs barrier-balanced. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 validations pass, but n2048 retains the exact repair residual signature. Full geomean is 25524.271 us and n2048 333213.023 us versus 25340.591/305506.561 for corrected group 1. The N16 group-2 B/TMEM split is therefore not yet semantically correct in this eight-CTA topology, and the coarser pair barriers add 27.7 ms.

Established the first semantically valid native n2048 terminal: only rank 0 of each eight-CTA reducer cluster owns a group-1 TMEM allocation and issues M128xN128 four-term TF32 updates with validated K-major packing and M128 readback. Fixed the widened tile-column stride from 16 to 128. Kernelguard and 39/39 validation pass; ordinary n2048 now shows custom residuals 3.68/3.04 rather than repair residuals 0.017/0.006. Full geomean is 25318.677 us and n2048 302132.233 us. Nsys measures reduce_n2048_resident at 291.143 ms with no cuSOLVER fallback, showing rank-0-only serialized native staging/wait/readback is the dominant cost.

Widened the valid rank-0 native primitive from M128xN128 to SM100's maximum M128xN256, expanded TMEM allocation to 256 columns, and halved column-tile commits/waits/barriers while preserving four-term arithmetic. Build, kernelguard, and 39/39 validation pass with custom n2048 residuals 3.40/3.03. Full geomean improves 25318.677->25152.457 us and n2048 302132.233->281676.392 us. The 20.46 ms target gain confirms barrier/A-staging amortization, but unchanged total TMEM readback and two cluster barriers per tile still dominate.

Removed both per-tile eight-CTA cluster barriers from the rank-0 M128xN256 native loop, retaining CTA-local staging/readback barriers and relying on the existing panel grid barrier after disjoint scalar fringe work. Build, kernelguard, and 39/39 validation pass with unchanged custom n2048 residuals. Full geomean improves 25152.457->25129.454 us and n2048 281676.392->275541.636 us. The 6.13 ms gain shows cluster synchronization mattered, but rank-0 TMEM readback/global stores and serialized tile issue remain dominant.

Computed only M128xN256 tiles intersecting the lower triangle, skipped upper scalar-fringe stores, then mirrored the completed lower triangle with the full resident grid before the next panel. Build, kernelguard, and 39/39 validation pass with custom n2048 residuals 3.36/2.91. Full geomean is 25164.846 us and n2048 281705.882 us, regressing from 25129.454/275541.636: eliminating upper native tiles does not repay an extra full-triangle copy and grid barrier on every width-8 panel.

Restored the full-square N256 producer and narrowed TMEM readback from tcgen05.ld.32x32b.x16 to x4, reducing each reader thread's live result registers from 16 to four while quadrupling load/wait groups. Build, kernelguard, and 39/39 validation pass, but n2048 regresses from 275541.636 to 308161.764 us and aggregate from 25129.454 to 25359.032 us. Unlike the prior n1024 native pipeline, this N256 epilogue is instruction/wait limited enough that x16 is materially better than x4.

Native sm100a tcgen05 M128xN256 with x32 TMEM readback; 39/39 valid, aggregate 25249.229068, n2048 291649.038 us. Wider x32 readback regressed versus x16 best. Nsight capture: profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25/brief-78-trial-9-x32.nsys-rep (helper stats suffix error after successful capture).

Column-stationary native tcgen05 schedule packs B once then sweeps all M128 row tiles; 39/39 valid, aggregate 25558.191472, n2048 343646.332 us. Large regression matches 64 coarse tasks over 15 clusters causing 5-vs-4 task load imbalance.

Column-stationary tcgen05 schedule split into four-row groups to retain 4x B reuse and 256 early tasks; 39/39 valid, aggregate 25472.439381, n2048 326643.667 us. Better than whole-column tasks but late-panel task collapse still regresses versus flat schedule.

Row-stationary native tcgen05 schedule reuses packed M128 A across groups of four N256 tiles while retaining late-panel row tasks; 39/39 valid, aggregate 25382.735206, n2048 312155.741 us. Still regresses, showing operand packing savings do not repay reduced flat scheduling freedom.

Removed <mma.h> and every WMMA namespace reference; native path now uses explicit cvt.rna.tf32.f32 plus sm100a tcgen05. Full 39/39 valid, aggregate 25330.297568, n2048 308077.922 us. Timing matches x4 TMEM baseline; lineage audit found x32 revert had restored x4 rather than x16.

WMMA-free sm100a native tcgen05 M128xN256 flat scheduler with x16 TMEM readback. Full 39/39 valid; repeat aggregate 25121.465528, n2048 275536.662 us. Cubin sm_100a, reducer REG92/LOCAL0, SASS four UTCHMMA plus LDTM.x16. Nsight reducer avg 265.053 ms (96.3% GPU kernel time), report profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25/brief-78-trial-14-native-x16.nsys-rep.

Blackwell tcgen05.mma.ws collector b0 fill/lastuse reuses B_v across the final two TF32 MMAs. 39/39 valid; repeat aggregate 25139.124553, n2048 275506.856 us (neutral within noise, slightly below 275536.662 baseline). SASS UTCHMMA.WS B_KEEP/B_REUSE, REG92/LOCAL0.

Vectorized each x16 TMEM epilogue chunk as four aligned float4 load/subtract/store groups. SASS changes 16 scalar LDG/STG pairs to four LDG.E.128/STG.E.128 pairs while keeping UTCHMMA.WS, REG92/LOCAL0. Full 39/39 valid; aggregate 23947.335134, n2048 143566.971 us versus 275506.856 us, a 1.919x affected-shape speedup.

Vectorized x32 TMEM readback halves LDTM waits with unchanged LDG.E.128/STG.E.128 transaction count, but raises reducer to REG96/STACK32 with local spill traffic. Full 39/39 valid; aggregate 24088.632654, n2048 153281.982 us, 6.8% slower than spill-free vector x16.

Vectorized x8 TMEM readback keeps REG92/STACK0 and the same total 128-bit global transactions but doubles LDTM/wait count. Full 39/39 valid; aggregate 24369.619579, n2048 174690.044 us, 21.7% slower than vector x16. Together with spilling x32, x16 is the read-width optimum.

Post-vectorization control removes neutral tcgen05.mma.ws collector helpers and uses four ordinary native UTCHMMA instructions. Full 39/39 valid; aggregate 23939.540265, n2048 143340.068 us versus 143566.971 for WS. Nsight reducer avg 133.014 ms (92.9% GPU kernel time), report profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25/brief-78-trial-19-vector-x16-no-ws.nsys-rep. Simpler no-WS form selected.

For trailing panels >=512, zero-padded one extra native N256 tile to eliminate the scalar right strip while keeping bottom rows scalar and vector stores valid-only. Full 39/39 valid, REG96/STACK0; aggregate 24046.029346, n2048 153259.700 us, 6.9% slower than floor tiling. Padding/control cost exceeds scalar fringe.

Grouped fringe into aligned four-column work items with one noinline helper reusing row factors and float4 matrix I/O. Full 39/39 valid, but reducer rises to REG96/STACK8; aggregate 23963.945981, n2048 146583.613 us, 2.3% slower than scalar fringe. Call ABI/register contamination outweighs fringe savings.

Grouped fringe addressing/matrix float4 I/O but kept four scalar-return noinline eight-term dot calls, eliminating the prior stack frame. Full 39/39 valid, REG96/STACK0; aggregate 23971.540692, n2048 146787.486 us, still 2.4% slower. Any vector fringe grouping raises dominant-path registers; scalar fringe selected.

Removed post-MMA 608-thread CTA barrier; one lane in each of four reader warps observes mbarrier then __syncwarp before x16 readback, with final CTA barrier preserving operand lifetime. Full 39/39 valid, REG92/STACK0; aggregate 23906.106364, n2048 143332.728 us, effectively neutral versus 143340.068 baseline.

One lane observes tcgen05 completion then bar.sync 1,128 releases only the four TMEM reader warps, replacing four mbarrier polls and avoiding the 608-thread pre-read barrier. Full 39/39 valid, REG92/STACK0; aggregate 23907.760298, n2048 143292.608 us. Nsight reducer avg 132.924 ms vs 133.014 ms baseline, report profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25/brief-78-trial-24-vector-x16-reader-barrier.nsys-rep. Small stable win selected.

Uniformly gated native tile loop on cta==0 so ranks 1-7 skip empty barrier iterations and begin disjoint fringe work immediately. Full 39/39 valid; aggregate 23948.529359, n2048 143338.109 us, neutral versus 143292-143340 controls. Empty-loop overhead is not critical.
Move all scalar n2048 fringe work to ranks 1-7 so the rank-0 tcgen05 owner performs only native matrix tiles; 39/39 validation passed; n2048 138881.734 us versus 143292.608 us selected prior.

Schedule non-owner scalar fringe by warp-owned contiguous rows, eliminating most per-element variable divisions and coalescing columns; 39/39 passed; n2048 138666.794 us, marginally faster than 138881.734 us.
Explicitly hoist the first four row W/V factor pairs across warp-row fringe column loops; 39/39 passed; REG95 STACK0; n2048 138734.914 us versus 138666.794 us, neutral/slightly worse.

Reschedule native tcgen05 work by row tile and reuse converted A factors across all N256 columns; 39/39 passed; REG94 STACK0; cluster work granularity imbalance outweighed staging savings, n2048 139744.465 us versus 138666.794 us.
Split row-tile A reuse into balanced two-column work groups; 39/39 passed; added A staging dominated and n2048 regressed to 141172.930 us from 139744.465 us row-wide and 138666.794 us per-tile.

Use the n2048 factor stride third segment to precompute each W TF32 residual once during panel output and load it during repeated tcgen05 tile staging; 39/39 passed; REG95 STACK0; n2048 improved from 138666.794 to 138263.682 us.

Prepack n2048 panel workspace as W_hi/V_hi/W_low TF32 once, eliminate all repeated cvt/sub operations from tcgen05 tile staging, and reconstruct W_hi+W_low in scalar fringe; 39/39 passed; REG95 STACK0; n2048 137847.402 us and aggregate 23819.002681.

Use only packed W_hi/V_hi in scalar fringe while preserving four-term tcgen05 main tiles; 39/39 passed; n2048 137816.447 us, only 30.955 us faster than two-term fringe and below noise while numerical residuals worsened, so reject.

Prepack duplicate M128 and N256 K-major TF32 operand layouts in unused per-matrix workspace and replace scalar gather/swizzle staging with aligned float4 global-to-shared copies; 39/39 passed; REG96 STACK0; SASS LDG.E.128/STS.128 plus four UTCHMMA; n2048 137513.561 us, aggregate 23815.560779.

Replace cooperative float4 operand staging with CTA-scoped cp.async.bulk into shared, expect_tx mbarrier wait, then issue four tcgen05 MMAs; 39/39 passed; REG93 STACK0; SASS UBLKCP.S.G/SYNCS/UTCHMMA/LDTM.x16; n2048 134227.468 us, aggregate 23779.064980.

Double-buffer packed operands in shared and issue cp.async.bulk for tile i+1 immediately after tcgen05 commit for tile i, overlapping staging with MMA completion and TMEM readback; 39/39 passed; REG89 STACK8 LOCAL0; n2048 133467.625 us, aggregate 23762.103970.

Replace indexed double-buffer copy phases with one deterministic scalar phase toggled per buffer pair; 39/39 passed; resource use improved from REG89 STACK8 to REG90 STACK0 LOCAL0; n2048 131898.504 us, aggregate 23730.732340.

Terminal robustness audit on exact 07a18f9e6: nine full POPCORN_SEED transformed ranked benchmark suites 1,2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19 all returned check: pass; seed13 known n1024 edge passed without attributing inherited remote failure to n2048. Terminal Nsys reducer 121.604151 ms/call. Cubin sm_100a; REG90 STACK0 LOCAL0; SASS UBLKCP.S.G, 4 UTCHMMA, 16 LDTM.x16. n1024 d389ff2b hardening hunks are disjoint from native changes.

Allocate two N256 TMEM slots and issue tile i+1 before reading tile i so next tcgen05 MMA overlaps prior LDTM/vector epilogue; 39/39 passed; REG93 STACK0 LOCAL0; n2048 131902.924 us versus 131898.504 us single-slot, exactly neutral while using more registers/TMEM, reject.

Terminal exact-head confirmation after reverting neutral two-TMEM experiment; source blob matches selected trial 37. Full benchmark check pass: aggregate 23903.401941, n2048 132136.037 us. Exact-head Nsys reducer 121.648161 ms/call. Nine-seed transformed ranked audit passed on identical source. sm_100a cubin, no WMMA, REG90 STACK0 LOCAL0; SASS 8 UBLKCP.S.G, 4 UTCHMMA, 16 LDTM.x16 with vector 128-bit global IO. 39/39 validation passed and worktree clean.

Terminal commit 252887349130f18eeccf535e2197282d0e9f49d8 restores the selected source-identical trial-37 Blackwell-native reducer after rejecting neutral two-TMEM overlap. Exact-head 39/39 validation and full 13-shape benchmark passed: aggregate 23903.401941, n2048 132136.037 us. Exact-head Nsys reducer average 121.648161 ms (2 calls), sm_100a cubin, REG90 STACK0 LOCAL0, no WMMA; SASS has 8 UBLKCP.S.G, 4 UTCHMMA, 16 LDTM.x16 plus 128-bit global IO. Nine transformed ranked seed suites 1,2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19 all passed on the identical source blob, including seed13 n1024 edge. Brief77 d389ff2b n1024 hardening is hunk-disjoint and compatible for manager transplant. Worker made no leaderboard submission.
